name: EmergencyMusterTracker
tagline: Account for everyone underground – live muster board, refuge chambers and missing persons in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete underground emergency muster app: drill and emergency timer with accounted %, digital personnel tag board, muster point and refuge chamber occupancy with capacity rules, warden scan check-in, missing-persons search cards and drill history with time to 100 % accounted.
features: Drill / emergency muster timer vs target
No re-entry underground during a muster
Check-in with warden and capacity rules
Headcount by company incl. contractors and visitors
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
